name: placement-states
normalizations: Compare the state each block is placed in, by Block.getStateForPlacement and StandingAndWallBlockItem: on top of stone, against the north face of a stone block, and beside the first one.
Use matching flat terrain in creative mode, looking south and 30 degrees down; snapshots follow each block so its chunks are still loaded.
Fence, wall, pane and rail connections, scaffolding distance, plant survival and hanging signs are not covered yet.
